text: This staff report is about a matter for which the Toronto and East York Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. The Ward Councillor has requested operating conditions be imposed on the boulevard café permit located at 668 King Street West, Bathurst Street flankage.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Approved the application for the proposed boulevard café permit located at 668 King Street West, Bathurst Street flankage. 2. Approved the following operating conditions proposed by the Ward Councillor for the proposed boulevard café permit located at 668 King Street West, Bathurst Street flankage: a. Patio to close by 11:00 p.m. Sunday to Thursday nights; 1:00 a.m. Friday and Saturday (early Saturday and Sunday morning). b. No amplified sound or live music permitted on the patio. c. Signage in a prominent location will remind patrons to be considerate of the surrounding community.
